plan.name: Retry pinned downloads and clean up cancelled containers
plan.summary: Make toolchain file downloads and digest-pinned Docker pulls try at most three times, waiting one then two seconds with cancellation support after network failures, HTTP 5xx, 429 or CDN 403 responses, and registry failures, while returning the last diagnostic and stopping immediately on hash or digest mismatches and other permanent file-download errors. Before a Docker run needs a missing digest-pinned image, acquire that exact image and requested platform through the same retry path, keeping cached images, explicit --pull=never, local images, command arguments, proxy suppression, stdin, output and exit status intact, and retrying acquisition alone rather than builds or executed workloads. After cancellation removes the named container and stops its Docker client, remove that name again with a bounded independent cleanup context after the client has exited, completing cleanup before Run, Output, CombinedOutput or Start/Wait returns. Have both Python cancellation leak checks use a shared test-only pythonApplicationContainers(context.Context) (map[string]bool, error) listing restricted to invariant-<current pid>- names, so other processes cannot cause false leaks while this process's new containers remain detectable. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe these retries, cancellation cleanup and process-scoped leak checks, citing the existing pinning, isolation and cleanup decisions (including D-0016, D-0111 and D-0178) and this ratified plan; the merger records the new retry and cleanup decision, and CI runs the affected real Python and TLAPS suites under D-0286.

tests.name: TestPinnedFetchRecoversTransientFailures
tests.says: Network errors, interrupted response bodies, 5xx, 429 and CDN 403 responses retry with backoff and publish only checksum-verified bytes.

tests.name: TestPinnedFetchBoundsRetriesAndKeepsLastError
tests.says: A persistently failing download stops after three requests, reports the final failure and leaves no partial download.

tests.name: TestPinnedFetchStopsAtIntegrityOrPermanentFailure
tests.says: A retry that reaches corrupt bytes stops at the checksum error; immediate corruption and 404 responses are not retried, and valid cached files need no download.

tests.name: TestPinnedFetchCancellationInterruptsBackoff
tests.says: Cancellation during a retry delay stops promptly without another request or partial file.

tests.name: TestPinnedDockerPullRecoversRegistryFailures
tests.says: Explicit pinned pulls recover from two registry failures with bounded backoff through every command completion API.

tests.name: TestPinnedDockerPullBoundsRetriesAndStopsAtIntegrityFailure
tests.says: Persistent registry failures return their last diagnostic after three attempts, whereas a digest or layer verification mismatch stops immediately.

tests.name: TestPinnedDockerRunAcquiresImageWithoutRepeatingWork
tests.says: Missing pinned images are acquired before one workload execution, preserving platform, stdin, output, arguments and exit status; cached images, local images and pull-never runs retain their behavior.

tests.name: TestPinnedDockerPullCancellationInterruptsBackoff
tests.says: Cancellation interrupts image acquisition backoff without another pull or starting a workload.

tests.name: TestCancelledDockerRunRemovesLateCreatedContainer
tests.says: Every command completion API waits for a second removal after the Docker client exits, removing a container created after the first removal.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationLeakChecksIgnoreOtherProcesses
tests.says: The shared container listing used by both Python leak checks ignores new foreign-process containers, including PID-prefix collisions, but detects new containers from this process.
